verdicts.conflict: Whether federal procurement rules should rely primarily on pre-deployment static compliance gates or continuous post-deployment behavioral monitoring.
verdicts.rationale: Both camps cite valid real-world evidence, with accelerationists pointing to 12 to 18-month procurement delays and safetyists pointing to FAA physical testing precedents. Neither side provides empirical proof that their preferred oversight model prevents catastrophic failures while maintaining operational velocity.
verdicts.whatWouldChange: Comparative empirical studies showing whether continuous monitoring catches more operational failures than upfront static compliance gates.
